walk: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 2D RPG sprite animation sheet. Reference image 1 is the exact existing skeleton warrior identity, ivory bones, cyan eyes, brown leather vest and belt, worn sword and wooden round shield. Create only this SAME character, consistently sized and complete. A precisely arranged portrait sheet with EXACTLY THREE COLUMNS and EIGHT ROWS of separate full-body WALK poses. Rows in order: facing camera/down; down-left; left profile; up-left; away from camera/up (show back of skull); up-right; right profile; down-right. Columns in EVERY row: left foot forward, feet in neutral stance, right foot forward. Preserve character proportions and handcrafted detailed sprite style. Top-down three-quarter game camera, feet at same baseline within each cell; 3 equally spaced columns and 8 equally spaced rows. Each pose is isolated, entire head, torso, BOTH feet, sword and shield visible. Very generous transparent margins on all four sides of every sprite. No sprite can cross a cell boundary. No fragments, duplicate halves or limbs from neighbours. Exact 24 complete skeletons. No titles, labels, lines, grid, text or background or colored matte. Real transparent alpha, no magenta fringes. Keep all background transparent.
actionsDraft: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent sprite animation sheet for the same 2D top-down RPG skeleton archer. Reference image 1 is this game's existing skeleton: ivory bones, cyan eyes, leather vest/belt, turquoise buckle, wooden round shield. Keep that SAME identity, proportions and handcrafted style; change weapon to a wooden bow held in both hands, sword sheathed and shield secured on his back. EXACT THREE COLUMNS by EIGHT ROWS, 24 COMPLETE full-body skeleton figures on a portrait transparent sheet. Rows directions in order down, down-left, left, up-left, up/back, up-right, right, down-right. Columns: 1 raises bow and begins drawing; 2 fully drawn bow with nocked arrow AIMING along the row's direction; 3 just RELEASED arrow, bow arm extended, string relaxed, empty bow, skeleton's complete body still present. All row angles match the direction; back rows show back of head. Feet align to same baseline within each cell, equal spacing, generous transparent gutters. Arms, bow, head, BOTH feet completely inside each cell. No flying detached arrow replacing a figure. Clean genuine transparent alpha everywhere around figures; no magenta outlines, matte or glow. No text, labels, grid, background, extra objects or cut limbs. Exactly 24 complete bodies.
actionsRepair: Precise asset repair of the supplied skeleton animation sprite sheet. Preserve the same skeleton identity, brown leather armor, ivory bones, cyan eyes, wooden bow, full bodies, all 24 poses and 3-COLUMN / 8-ROW structure. Fix the inadequate spacing: make EACH figure substantially SMALLER within its allotted cell, about 65% of cell HEIGHT including bow. Put 40-50 pixels of completely TRANSPARENT empty air between EVERY row, at least 60 pixels between columns and at the outer edges. Every bow tip and BOTH feet must be fully visible and isolated; absolutely no adjacent poses can touch, overlap or share pixels. Re-arrange to precisely equal rows and columns. This is an animation atlas ready for cutting. Columns prepare/draw/release, rows down/down-left/left/up-left/up/up-right/right/down-right. Correct the third row so bow and nocked arrow point LEFT, not right. Show whole skeleton body in each of the three columns. No detached arrow in place of character. Remove ALL red, yellow, magenta or purple fringe pixels around outlines. Real transparent alpha background, no colored matte, grid or text. Portrait canvas.
